payload.text: Hold through WP02a, WP02b and WP07 (vc, 2026-10-31, for a consumer's re-cut): DEVBIN_RELEASE_CONFIRMED keeps its name and its value, the tag (--yes answers the confirm and sets it for the after: commands; a consumer's brew helper reads it), and release attach --from <dir> survives for object: local, WP07 adding the run keyed on the release commit's sha and removing nothing.
